skills.name: Writing a paragraph about human investment or a clean environment

note.text:
A good paragraph has one main idea: a topic sentence, supporting sentences (reasons, examples, facts) and a concluding sentence.
Human investment is unpaid work that people do together for the community, like cleaning a market or clearing gutters.
Use linking words (first, also, in addition, as a result) and the present tense for general facts.

worked_example.problem: Plan a paragraph: “Human investment keeps our quarter clean”.
steps: Topic sentence: Human investment keeps our quarter clean and healthy.
Support: on the last Saturday of each month we clear gutters, cut grass and collect plastic.
Result: fewer mosquitoes, no floods, a beautiful quarter.
worked_example.answer: topic sentence → supporting sentences → concluding sentence

cards.idea: Start with a topic sentence that gives the main idea.
example: Human investment keeps our quarter clean.

cards.idea: Support it with reasons and examples.
example: We clear the gutters every month.

questions.prompt: Put the sentences of the paragraph in order.

items.text: Human investment keeps our quarter clean and healthy.
On the last Saturday of each month we clear the gutters.
We also cut the grass and collect plastic bags.
As a result, there are fewer mosquitoes and no floods.
Everyone should take part in this work.

paper_task.prompt: Write a paragraph of about 100 words in your exercise book on “Human investment” or “Keeping our environment clean”.
model: Human investment keeps our quarter clean and healthy. On the last Saturday of each month, men, women and children come out with hoes, brooms and wheelbarrows. We clear the gutters, cut the tall grass and collect plastic bags from the roadside. The youths carry the rubbish to the bin at the junction. As a result, there are fewer mosquitoes and the gutters no longer overflow when it rains. Our quarter is also more beautiful, and visitors notice it. Human investment costs no money, but it needs everybody's effort. Everyone should take part.
checklist: My paragraph has one main idea.
I began with a topic sentence.
I ended with a concluding sentence.
